patches.reason: Remove only propagation-operation flags from the read-only bind remount after a successful initial private recursive bind; preserve MS_BIND, MS_RDONLY and inherited nosuid/nodev/noexec/time lock flags. AppArmor rejects the redundant propagation/remount combination. Remount failure still aborts sandbox creation.
patches.licenseImpact: Modified go-sandbox source remains MIT. Original license is retained byte-identically; source carries a prominent Code Startrack modification comment. No upstream isolation implementation is replaced.
patches.upgradeCondition: Rebase only against a reviewed exact go-sandbox pin. Recheck initial mount and namespace propagation flags, inherited statfs lock flags and remount failure behavior; qualify read-only write denial on every configured bind including nested mounts under the reviewed Linux AppArmor/capability profile.

patches.reason: Retain CAP_SETPCAP across exec only for the trusted nested namespace init so upstream keep_capability can set securebits under inherited no_new_privs. Actual prefork init had full namespace bounding capabilities but only the eight outer permitted/effective capabilities and lacked SETPCAP; its securebits transition returned EPERM. The outer capability set and AppArmor profile are unchanged, and upstream child DropCaps remains mandatory.
patches.licenseImpact: Modified go-sandbox source remains MIT with its original license retained byte-identically and a prominent Code Startrack modification comment. The reviewed upstream isolation, no_new_privs, securebits locking and child capability removal remain in place.
patches.upgradeCondition: Rebase only against a reviewed exact go-sandbox pin. Inspect startContainer, exec capability propagation, keep_capability securebits and DropCaps; qualify actual trusted-init execution, zero effective/permitted/inheritable/ambient child capabilities, measured namespace-scoped bounding set, locked securebits47 and no_new_privs1, actual capability-regain/mount/pivot_root/user-and-network-namespace denials, and credential isolation under the exact released Linux profile.

patches.reason: Supply the two zeroed CapUserData words required by Linux capability ABI v3 and pass element zero in each of the three existing CAPSET calls. The pinned single 12-byte structure let the kernel read the required second word from adjacent globals, potentially failing capability removal with EPERM. This repairs the existing intended zero-drop semantics without changing securebits, bounding-set, credential, namespace or seccomp policy.
patches.licenseImpact: Modified go-sandbox source remains MIT; original license stays byte-identical and a prominent Code Startrack comment identifies the ABI correction. Mature upstream isolation and failure propagation remain in place.
patches.upgradeCondition: Rebase only against a reviewed exact go-sandbox pin. Verify the Linux capability header version, full kernel data size, all CAPSET call sites and zero-array bytes in the actual Linux ELF; rerun child capability, securebits, no_new_privs, capability-regain denial, compiler/reference/validator and full sandbox verdict/security qualification.
